scenes.summary: You look at the path behind you. The Blight Miasma has vanished. The Sentry Bases built by the Wulingers glitter in the sunset.

lines.text: {F}Yes, the very road we took.{M}Yes, the very road we took.
Much of the Blight Miasma has dissipated... I believe the Tianshi reinforcements have arrived.
The pillars ... and the path taken by the Tianshi...
That will be ... the first light to shine upon the revival of our homes.
{F}Soon, the name "Exclusion Zone" will no longer apply to this place.{M}Soon, the name "Exclusion Zone" will no longer apply to this place.
{F}But now, we must keep going.{M}But now, we must keep going.

scenes.summary: Chen grabs Arcane, who's lost in thought. Together, you all leave the Wuling Very Large Rift.

lines.text: What are you looking at? Come on. Let's go.
But you're right. We gotta go.
Go down here and we'll reach the target location.
The Very Large Rift... This is the final objective of the Operation, Endmin.
True. We cannot afford to make a mistake here. Best run a few more checks.

options: We shall face the Very Large Rift!
